data: What is the accuracy of the yellow line when the x-axis value is 80 in the second figure?

The question asks for the accuracy of the yellow line when the x-axis value is 80 in the second figure. From the caption, we know that the yellow line represents CNN. In the second figure (b), the x-axis is labeled as the qth percentile, and the y-axis represents accuracy. At x = 80, the yellow line (CNN) appears to be at approximately 0.85. Therefore, the accuracy of the yellow line when the x-axis value is 80 in the second figure is around 0.85.
